terra.problem: “I know how hard that is” presents giving the firstfruits as difficult, though the text does not say it was.
The comment that surplus is a fancy word that sounds smart comes across as patronizing toward the baker.
“Wrong street” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The reference to Papa waiting in the dark draws on his backstory without identifying the drawer.
“Nobody’s going backwards” and “the direction of this rescue is forward” add a direction to the journey that this declaration does not give.
The fact that Sinai was a stop on Israel’s journey is outside this passage and needs a reference.
“A whole harvest” overstates the offering, which is some firstfruits. The text also says the worshiper bows, not that he bends his knee.
The text calls for rejoicing but does not say the ceremony ends in a celebration or worship service.
The text includes the foreigner in the rejoicing, but does not say the good things are distributed among households or describe a celebration the foreigner attends.
The instruction to rejoice does not establish that nobody is skipping a meal.
A seat at the table suggests a shared meal, which the text does not describe.
“Every day” adds a frequency to a command about following with all the heart and soul.
